question: What does the designation HLVM3 stand for in the Gaganyaan mission context?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Human LVM3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The designation **HLVM3** stands for **Human LVM3**, which refers to the modified version of the Launch Vehicle Mark-3 (LVM3) developed by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) for the Gaganyaan mission.
 
• **LVM3**, also known as GSLV Mk-III, is India’s heaviest and most advanced rocket, capable of launching payloads up to 8 tons into low Earth orbit.
 
• For the Gaganyaan mission, LVM3 has been customized to carry humans safely into space, integrating advanced safety features such as an abort system and life-support mechanisms.
 
• The HLVM3 is equipped with a crew module and service module designed to house astronauts and ensure their safety during the mission.
 
• The Gaganyaan program aims to send a crew of three astronauts into low Earth orbit for a duration of up to seven days using the HLVM3 rocket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gaganyaan Mission:**

 
 
• The Gaganyaan mission is India’s first human spaceflight program, aimed at demonstrating the capability of sending astronauts into space and bringing them back safely.
 
• It involves critical technologies such as crew safety systems, life-support systems, space medicine, and crew training.
 
• The program is a significant milestone in India’s space exploration journey and aims to position India as a key player in human spaceflight capabilities.
